u0: Accepting base state: the siren is off and the agent holds no food, with no prepared hand-off pending. If a client is waiting without an order, take the order; if an order is already taken, fetch raw food from the pantry; otherwise wait for the next client. If the siren starts, enter u1 and silence it. This is the RM final state, but the episode continues.
u1: Urgent empty-handed siren state: the siren is ringing and no food is carried. Go to the siren switch and toggle it off; this returns to u0 while any client order remains pending. Taking an order while the siren is on keeps the agent here, and picking up food before silencing moves to u3; do not serve while ringing.
u2: Safe carrying state: food is in hand and the siren is off, but the food is not yet prepared for hand-off. If the waiting client has not ordered, take the order; then go to the stove and toggle to prepare. Preparation while silent moves to u4. If the siren starts, enter u3; if the food is lost, enter u6.
u3: Carrying food while the siren is ringing: hands are full and the siren is on. Keep the food and go to the switch; toggling it off while still holding food moves to u2. After silencing, resume order-taking and preparation. Preparing before silencing moves to u5, losing the food moves to u7, and serving while ringing is forbidden.
u4: Prepared food ready and safe: a prepared portion is held, the client's order has been taken, and the siren is off. Go to the client and serve without a ring already active; a safe serve gives +1 and moves to u0, or to u1 if the siren is ringing after the step. If the siren starts beforehand, move to u5; if the prepared food slips, move to u8.
u5: Prepared food held while the siren is ringing: this is the dangerous ready-to-serve state. Do not toggle the client, because serving now would be served_while_ringing and is penalized. First go to the siren switch and toggle it off while keeping the prepared food, moving to u4; then serve from u4. If the food leaves the hands, move to u9.
u6: Empty-handed safe recovery state: no food is carried and the siren is off, typically after raw food was lost or after silencing while empty. If a portion just slipped, pick it up on the very next move; otherwise take a waiting client's order if needed and fetch a new portion from the pantry. Picking up food moves to u2, or to u3 if the siren is on; a new ring while still empty moves to u7.
u7: Empty-handed siren state in the recovery or order branch: the siren is ringing and no food is carried. If a slipped portion is waiting, recover it on the very next move, which moves to u3 and still requires silencing; otherwise go to the switch and toggle it off, moving to u6. Do not serve, and avoid lingering empty while the siren rings.
u8: Prepared-food recovery state with the siren off: the order has reached the cooking or hand-off stage, but the prepared portion is no longer in hand. If it just slipped, pick it up on the very next move; doing so while silent returns to u4 with prepared food ready to serve. If no recoverable portion remains, reacquire and prepare food to complete the order. If the siren starts while still empty, move to u9.
u9: Empty-handed while the prepared-food task is unfinished and the siren is ringing: the cooked portion has been lost or dropped. Recover a just-fallen prepared portion on the very next move if possible, which moves to u5 and still forbids serving until the siren is silenced; otherwise go to the switch and toggle it off, moving to u8. Then recover or prepare food and serve only after the siren is off.
